### MarketAxess Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


October 23, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s201.q4cdn.com/767283836/files/content_files/Q3_2026-Earnings-Release-FINAL.pdf)


***EPS of $1.53; $1.86 Excluding Notable Items1***


***1% Revenue Growth Reflects Strong Information Services Revenue Growth of 10%***


***21% Increase in Block Trading ADV and 37% Increase in Portfolio Trading ADV with Broad-Based Growth***


***Across U.S. Credit, Emerging Markets and Eurobond Block ADVs***


***Continued Focus on Expense Discipline***


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


MarketAxess Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: MKTX), the operator of a leading electronic trading platform for fixed-income securities, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**3Q26 Select Financial and Operational Highlights** (All comparisons vs 3Q25)


- Total revenues of **$210.4 million increased 1%** .


- Total commission revenue of **$179.9 million** was **flat** compared to the prior year.
- **6%** growth in services revenue 2 to **$30.5 million** .
- **6%** growth in revenue outside U.S. credit.


- Total trading average daily volume ("ADV") **increased 13%** , with growth across both credit and rates products, and market share gains in high yield and municipal bonds.
- Continued progress across key **strategic initiative channels** :


- ***Client-Initiated Channel :*** **21%** **increase** in block trading ADV to **$5.4 billion** , including **** U.S. credit up **24%** , Eurobonds up **16%** and emerging markets up **15%** .
- ***Portfolio Trading Channel :* 37%** **increase** in total portfolio trading ADV to **$1.9 billion** with **39%** growth in U.S. credit and **41%** growth in emerging markets.
- ***Dealer-Initiated Channel :*** **2%** **increase** in dealer-initiated ADV to **$1.5 billion** , which includes a **196%** increase in Mid-X ADV.


- Total expenses of **$136.0 million** increased **10%** ; total expenses, excluding notable items, 1 of **$122.9** **million** were flat, **** reflecting continued expense discipline.
- Operating margin of **35.4%** decreased **560bps** ; operating margin, excluding notable items, of **41.6%** increased **60bps** . Operating leverage of **(960)bps** , or **+100bps** , excluding notable items. 1
- Diluted earnings per share (“EPS”) of **$1.53** on net income of **$54.0** **million** , compared to **$1.84** and **$68.3 million** in the prior year, **** respectively; EPS of **$1.86** on net income of **$65.7 million** , each excluding notable items. 1


**Chris Concannon, CEO of MarketAxess, commented** :


**"In the third quarter, we continued to execute on our product roadmap across major trading protocols. We launched our enhanced X-Pro RFQ experience to U.S. credit clients, bringing price and spread trading, targeted and direct block workflows and AI-powered dealer selection into a single modern interface. We also delivered the new issue workflow in X-Pro, so clients can access primary and secondary markets side-by-side. Within portfolio trading, we rolled out further enhancements, including CP+ pricing and pre-trade analytics, enabling clients to make faster and more informed decisions.** **Overall, we continue to make great progress across our strategic priorities and remain committed to delivering innovative solutions that enhance the trading experience for our clients."**

**Commissions Revenue**


- Commissions revenue of **$179.9 million** was **flat** compared to the prior year.


***Credit***


— Total credit commission revenue of **$161.2 million** (including $34.8 million in fixed distribution fees) decreased **$3.8 million** , or **2%** , compared to $164.9 million (including $34.1 million in fixed distribution fees) in the prior year. The decrease was primarily driven by a 4% decrease in U.S. credit commission revenue reflecting lower variable transaction fee per million ("FPM"), partially offset by higher market volumes and fixed distribution fees. Total credit ADV increased **7%** compared to the prior year, mainly due to market share gains in high yield and municipal bonds, volume growth in emerging markets, and higher market activity. Total credit FPM decreased **9%** compared to the prior year, largely due to protocol and product mix, as well as lower duration of bonds traded in U.S. high-grade.


***Rates***


— Total rates commission revenue of **$8.9 million** increased **$2.3 million** , or **34%,** compared to the prior year, primarily driven by higher U.S. Treasury volumes and improved FPM.


***Other***


— Total other commission revenue of **$9.8 million** increased **$1.2 million** , or **14%** , compared to the prior year, primarily driven by higher trading volumes.


**Services Revenue**


- Services revenue 2 of **$30.5 million** increased **$1.8 million** , or **6%** , compared to the prior year.


***Information Services***


— Information services revenue of **$15.2 million** increased **$1.4 million** , or **10%** , compared to the prior year. The increase was principally driven by net new contract revenue.


***Post-trade Services***


— Post-trade services revenue of **$11.4 million** increased **$0.2 million** , or **1%** , compared to the prior year, mainly due to net new contract revenue.


***Technology Services***


— Total technology services revenue of **$3.9 million** increased **$0.3 million** , or **8%** , compared to the prior year, largely reflecting higher broker execution and port fees.


**Expenses**


- Total expenses of **$136.0 million** increased **10%** from the prior year. Total expenses, excluding notable items, 1 of **$122.9 million** were flat compared to the prior year.


**Non-operating**


- **Other income (expense):** Other income was **$0.4** **million** , down from **$8.1 million** in the prior year. The decrease was largely driven by receipt of a tax credit in the prior year, lower interest income resulting from lower average cash balances, higher interest expense mainly due to borrowings on the Company’s credit facility, which, along with cash on hand, were used to fund the accelerated stock repurchase agreement that settled in 1Q26, and higher foreign currency transaction losses.
- **Tax rate:** The effective tax rate was **27.8%** , compared to **27.1%** in the prior year. The effective tax rate excluding notable items 1 was **25.4%** , compared to **27.1%** in the prior year.


**Capital**


- The Company had **$539.6 million** in cash, cash equivalents, corporate bond investments and U.S. Treasury investments as of **September 30, 2026** , down from **$678.9 million** as of **December 31, 2025** . The decline from year-end 2025 primarily reflects capital allocation activity during the first nine months of 2026, including share repurchases, repayment of $128.0 million of borrowings under the revolving credit facility and quarterly dividends, as well as an increase in net receivables from broker-dealers, clearing organizations and customers, partially offset by cash generated from operating activities. The Company had **$92.0** million in borrowings outstanding under the Company’s credit facility as of **September 30, 2026** , as compared to **$220.0 million** in borrowings outstanding as of **December 31, 2025** .
- The Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of **$0.78** per share, payable on **November 25, 2026** to stockholders of record as of the close of business on **November 11, 2026** .


**Other**


- Employee headcount was **858** as of **September** **30, 2026** , compared to **896** as of **September 30,** **2025** , and **863** as of **June 30, 2026.**

**Non-GAAP Financial Measures and Other Items**


To supplement the Company’s unaudited financial statements presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles (“GAAP”), the Company uses certain non-GAAP financial measures, including earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (“EBITDA”), EBITDA margin and free cash flow. From time to time, we present selected GAAP-basis financial results, excluding notable items. Notable items are revenues, expenses, other income (expense) and tax related items that are not indicative of ongoing operating performance and outside of the Company’s normal course of business, including merger, acquisition and restructuring charges or gains/losses on sales or other notables (collectively, “notable items”). We define Operating leverage, excluding notable items, as the year-over-year percentage change in revenues less the year-over-year percentage change in expenses, excluding notable items, for the respective period. We define EBITDA margin as EBITDA divided by revenues. We define free cash flow as net cash provided by/(used in) operating activities excluding the net change in trading investments and net change in securities failed-to-deliver and securities failed-to-receive from broker-dealers, clearing organizations and customers, less expenditures for furniture, equipment and leasehold improvements and capitalized software development costs. Non-GAAP financial measures should be considered in addition to, not as a substitute for or superior to, financial measures determined in conformity with GAAP. The Company believes that these non-GAAP financial measures, when taken into consideration with the corresponding GAAP financial measures, provide additional information regarding the Company’s operating results because they assist both investors and management in analyzing and evaluating the performance of our business. Please refer to Tables 8A, 8B, 9 and 10 for a reconciliation of: (i) selected GAAP-basis financial results, each excluding notable items, to their most directly comparable GAAP measure; (ii) GAAP net income to EBITDA and GAAP net income margin to EBITDA margin; and (iii) GAAP net cash provided by/(used in) operating activities to free cash flow, in each case, the most directly comparable GAAP measure.


**ICE Transaction**


On July 29, 2026, MarketAxess entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”) with Intercontinental Exchange, Inc. (“ICE”) and Igloo Merger Sub II, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of ICE. Under the Merger Agreement, the ICE subsidiary will merge with and into MarketAxess (the “Merger”), and MarketAxess will survive as a wholly owned subsidiary of ICE. At the effective time of the Merger, each outstanding share of MarketAxess common stock will be converted into the right to receive $167.00 in cash, without interest, other than certain excluded shares, including shares held by stockholders who properly exercise appraisal rights under Delaware law. On October 21, 2026, the Department of Justice and the Federal Trade Commission granted early termination of the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended, applicable to the Merger. Completion of the Merger remains subject to MarketAxess stockholder approval, the receipt of required regulatory approvals and the satisfaction or waiver of the other closing conditions in the Merger Agreement. A copy of the press release announcing the Merger can be found on the Investor Relations section of the MarketAxess corporate website at[http://investor.marketaxess.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.marketaxess.com&esheet=54627655&newsitemid=20261022207701&lan=en-US&anchor=http%3A%2F%2Finvestor.marketaxess.com&index=1&md5=9ba95fd46191204b1d97201f4c871589) .


In light of the Merger, MarketAxess has suspended the practice of hosting an earnings conference call. Further, MarketAxess has suspended the practice of issuing guidance and has withdrawn its previously announced 2026 annual guidance, as well as its medium-term financial targets. Finally, MarketAxess has suspended its practice of issuing monthly volumes press releases.


**General Notes Regarding the Data Presented**


Reported MarketAxess volume in all product categories includes only fully electronic trading volume. MarketAxess trading volumes and the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (“FINRA”) Trade Reporting and Compliance Engine (“TRACE”) reported volumes are available on the Company’s website at[investor.marketaxess.com/volume](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestor.marketaxess.com%2Fvolume&esheet=54627655&newsitemid=20261022207701&lan=en-US&anchor=investor.marketaxess.com%2Fvolume&index=2&md5=fcbd8a0bb3c8ebecfb25b844a2964dcd) .

**About MarketAxess**


MarketAxess (Nasdaq: MKTX) operates a leading electronic trading platform that delivers greater trading efficiency, a diversified pool of liquidity and significant cost savings to institutional investors and broker-dealers across the global fixed-income and other markets. Approximately 2,100 firms leverage MarketAxess’ patented technology to efficiently trade fixed-income securities. Our automated and algorithmic trading solutions, combined with our integrated and actionable data offerings, help our clients make faster, better-informed decisions on when and how to trade on our platform. MarketAxess’ award-winning Open Trading® marketplace is widely regarded as the preferred all-to-all trading solution in the global credit markets. Founded in 2000, MarketAxess connects a robust network of market participants through an advanced full trading lifecycle solution that includes automated trading solutions, intelligent data and index products and a range of post-trade services. Learn more at[www.marketaxess.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.marketaxess.com&esheet=54627655&newsitemid=20261022207701&lan=en-US&anchor=www.marketaxess.com&index=4&md5=7dc7a7f246c0c26d211b853d50c49b64) and on X[@MarketAxess](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Ftwitter.com%2Fmarketaxess%3Flang%3Den&esheet=54627655&newsitemid=20261022207701&lan=en-US&anchor=%40MarketAxess&index=5&md5=4d56b7d47df7b12db05a853794e685a3) .
